subject.title: [Feature]: Show compaction savings and live run time in Control UI

question: Should Control UI adopt both inline observability metrics as one sponsored core UX enhancement?
rationale: The request adds persistent user-visible presentation and timing behavior, and its protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human sponsorship even though it aligns with VISION.md.

options.title: Sponsor the combined enhancement
options.body: Implement both metrics through existing checkpoint and run-lifecycle ownership, adding no protocol or config surface unless technically unavoidable.

options.title: Narrow or defer the scope
options.body: Keep the issue open but prioritize only one metric or defer both until the checkpoint projection and lifecycle semantics are further specified.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the combined enhancement
recommendation.body: Implement both metrics through existing checkpoint and run-lifecycle ownership, adding no protocol or config surface unless technically unavoidable.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete product behavior and are also connected to recent active-run state work.
